claims.title: Individual hard money
claims.statement: FEC transactions can identify network principals' direct contributions to candidates and committees.

elements.text: Contributor identity confirmed beyond name match
Recipient, date, cycle, amount, and transaction identity
Member or candidate key and committee relationship

claims.title: Corporate PAC money
claims.statement: FEC filings can identify ANTHROPAC receipts and disbursements involving candidates and members.

elements.text: Committee identity and registration
Schedule A or B transaction with amount and date
Recipient member or candidate key

claims.title: Super PAC and c4 two-hop money
claims.statement: Primary filings and self-disclosures can trace network receipts and separate second-hop independent expenditures.

elements.text: First-hop receipt into a super PAC or c4
Second-hop independent expenditure and supported or opposed candidate
Hop value and non-coordination caveat

claims.title: Lobbying and lobbyist contributions
claims.statement: LDA records can show network lobbying and keep registered lobbyists' own contributions as a distinct second hop.

elements.text: LD-1 or LD-2 registrant, client, period, issues, and amount
Named bills, lobbyists, and covered positions
LD-203 contribution separately marked hop two

claims.title: Personnel revolving door
claims.statement: Public payroll and organization records can establish personnel moves between the network and Congress.

elements.text: Public person identity and current role
Prior role and organization with start and end dates
Member or committee key where applicable

claims.title: Grants to member-facing intermediaries
claims.statement: Award pages and tax filings can identify grants to institutions with a documented member-facing function.

elements.text: Award or filed grant with funder, recipient, date, amount, and money type
Documented member-facing function
Second-hop label where a grantee has a political arm

claims.title: Congress to network
claims.statement: Federal records can identify contracts, grants, appropriations, and legislative language benefiting a network entity.

elements.text: Federal award or contract record with recipient and amount
Appropriation, NDAA, or earmark text naming the entity or program
Legislative sponsor or institutional route without causal attribution

claims.title: Member holdings and household ties
claims.statement: Public financial disclosures can identify member or household exposure to Anthropic-related assets and employment.

elements.text: Member, filer, year, and disclosure type
Asset, vehicle, value band, or transaction
Household relation and public basis where applicable

claims.title: Privately funded travel and events
claims.statement: House and Senate disclosures can identify sponsored travel, gifts, and events involving network entities.

elements.text: Traveler or recipient and member key
Sponsor, destination or event, dates, and reported value
Approval or disclosure record

claims.title: Vendor relationships
claims.statement: Expenditure records can identify campaigns or offices paying network firms and network committees paying ex-Hill vendors.

elements.text: Payer, payee, date, amount, and purpose
Vendor identity and documented network relationship
Member, committee, campaign, or office key

claims.title: Congressional attention
claims.statement: Official records can enumerate hearings, statements, letters, releases, and posts that name network entities.

elements.text: Dated speaker, venue, and member key
Verbatim text naming the entity
Stance classification grounded in the quoted text

claims.title: State-level money and lobbying
claims.statement: State disclosure records can identify network money and lobbying involving state officials.

elements.text: State filer or registrant identity
Transaction or lobbying filing with date, amount, and issue
Governor, attorney general, legislator, or candidate key
